explanation: NTILE(2) counts rows, not values: four rows make two halves of two, taken in the sort order. product_id breaks the tie at 5.28, so 1148 comes before 1166 and the tied pair is split, 1148 in half 1 and 1166 in half 2. NTILE never keeps tied values together; only the tie-break decides which tied row goes first, so a query without one could put either product in half 1.
